Chapter 6808: Do Not Know

Chapter 6808: Do Not Know

“No rush.” Li Qiye smiled and shook his head.

“Just preparing for the worst.” The city lord whispered: “Just remember, as long as the shrine is around, there will be hope for Tinyleaf, you will see a miracle.”

“What miracle?” Li Qiye asked.

“I don’t know, I’m just sure that it is miraculous, please, the chosen one, don’t forget.” He repeated.

Even if all of them were to be killed soon, he still hoped Li Qiye would keep the shrine safe.

Li Qiye only smiled while staring at the shrine.

Meanwhile, the conversation between Thunder Emperor and Blaze Ancestor didn’t appear to be going well.

“Ancestor, dwelling on this matter is unnecessary. Everyone is trying to survive in Stygian, we must work together or a collapse is inevitable. Golden Lamp will extinguish.” She said.

“There is something off about this.” The ancestor frowned.

Despite her status and power being inferior, she still argued with the ancestor.

“What is it?” She asked.

“Frenzy had left Golden Lamp before, why are they back to target Tinyleaf?” He said.

“They have joined Dark Desire, going deeper and deeper into madness. We can’t use logic to gauge them.” She said.

“While that’s true, Primal Eagle is not impulsive and will find it difficult to return to Golden Lamp.” He said.

“I understand why you are skeptical, Ancestor, but this can’t be the reason to reject Tinyleaf. Solidarity makes us stronger.” She said.

Listeners couldn’t help but see a glimmer of hope after seeing the emperor’s resolute determination.

“Thunder, mind your tongue.” A big shot behind the ancestor said.

“As the ruler of Thunder Kingdom, I am responsible for protecting Golden Lamp. Please present the reasoning for doing otherwise.” She said.

“No need to lose temper.” The ancestor said: “Let me ask first.”

Having said that, he stared at the city lord. A king-realm cultivator couldn’t hide anything due to the power gap.

“Why did Frenzy attack your city?” He asked.

“Ancestor, I do not know the reason.” The city lord trembled while bowing.

“No sign at all?” He asked again, sending his gaze into the city lord’s mind.

The divinity overwhelmed the city lord, forcing him down on his knees.

“I didn’t notice anything.” The city lord truly had no idea.

“Was there anything strange happening in your city before the attack?” He asked.

The city lord thought of something but didn’t wish to speak. He lowered his head, winking secretly at Li Qiye.

Alas, how could a mortal escape an ancient ancestor?

“Speak.” The ancestor naturally noticed this.

The city lord focused his mind, wishing to resist the ancestor’s divinity.

Thunder Emperor frowned and said: “City Lord, tell us about the strange event.”

“Speak!” The ancestor raised his voice and forcefully bent the city lord’s mind.

He felt his mind shattering, seemingly plunging straight into hell. He couldn’t help but blurt: “It was not a strange event, only our Tinyleaf’s shrine glowing for a moment.”

“A shrine?” The ancestor furrowed his brows.

“It is just a family heirloom, a trinket.” He said timidly.

“Let me take a look.” The ancestor said.

He mustered all of his strength to disobey while muttering something at Li Qiye, signaling for him to somehow escape.
